preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 400,000.
The diameter d must be at least 1 and at most n - 1.
The maximum degree k must be at least 1 and at most n - 1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if d > n - 1 or k < 2 else True
postconditions.description: If the diameter d is greater than n - 1 or k is less than 2, output 'NO'.
If a valid tree exists, output 'YES' followed by n - 1 edges.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
postconditions.description: All vertices in the edges must be within the range from 1 to n.
